findings: 無繩自縛 preserves Baizhang Huaihai as utterer inside the continuous master-said/further-said discourse.
禪人 correctly distinguishes Liu Chongqing's signed preface, Yinyuan Longqi's formal address, and two duplicated editorial headings from the following authored texts.
剎竿 and 白拈賊 translate the explicit verse-says frame while retaining reviewed-unnamed verse authors rather than assigning the verses to the compiler.
立定腳跟 preserves Zhean Jingfan as speaker and correctly treats Yunmen in the closing warning as monastery deixis, not Yunmen Wenyan.
護生 preserves the unnamed ancient verse author as utterer and Nanshi Wenxiu as later raiser.
長老 preserves the five hundred unnamed immortals as collective utterers and Ananda as addressee.
無縫塔 preserves Fahai Li as utterer under the explicit mounting-the-seat and addressing-the-assembly frame.
